text:
maria-cs: FYI incoming escalation from ACME — they report duplicate partial outputs after an SSE disconnect + client reconnect. Also seeing double billing for the same request. repro attached.

maria-cs: Repro summary: user opens SSE stream, network blip (~2s), client retries with exponential backoff. After reconnect, server resumed but also replayed a short completion fragment -> user sees repeated fragment and charged for both.

maria-cs: Customer log snippet:
```
GET /v1/streams?session=abc123
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
[data chunk] token ids 0-24
--- network error ---
client reconnect after 1.5s: Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
GET /v1/streams?session=abc123&resume=token-42
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
[data chunk] token ids 0-24
[data chunk] token ids 25-99
```

maria-cs: They say the first "data chunk" was re-emitted instead of resuming only the subsequent tokens. Billing shows two charges for overlapping token ranges.

kyle-runtime: @maria-cs can you paste the exact resume token header they sent? suspect sidecar/backoff mismatch where sidecar retries a request upstream without propagating the client's resume idempotency header.

maria-cs: customer provided header: `X-Resume-Token: token-42` and their sidecar logs show an immediate retry on 502 with standard retry logic. Logs: `sidecar retry attempt=1 status=502 upstream=req-id=xyz`

ben-infra: quick look — our upstream accepts resume tokens to return an offset resume. If the sidecar retries the original initial connection (instead of forwarding the resume token on reconnect), the runtime may issue overlapping output. Also backoff timing can cause multiple in-flight attempts if the client reconnects while sidecar is still retrying.

dave-oncall: marking P1 for now until we confirm duplication rate. @kyle-runtime please confirm if requests that get retried by sidecar preserve `X-Resume-Token` and any idempotency keys. If not, we likely need to stop auto-retrying streaming accepts at sidecar and let the client handle reconnect semantics.

kyle-runtime: digging in. quick repro I ran locally: client disconnect -> sidecar retries to upstream (sidecar kept original `Connection: keep-alive` socket open), upstream accepted and replayed prefix. If the client then reconnects with a resume token pointing to a later offset, race causes both to be processed and both bill.

kyle-runtime: snippet from sidecar log: `retry_handler.go:120 attempt=1 forwarding_headers=[Authorization X-Request-Id]` — resume header not in the forwarded set. So sidecar retries drop `X-Resume-Token`.

maria-cs: ouch. customer sent `X-Idempotency-Key` as well but sidecar doesn't forward that either. They rely on idempotency to dedupe.

ben-infra: quick mitigation: 1) add a header-forward rule to include `X-Resume-Token` and `X-Idempotency-Key` for retries, 2) temporarily disable sidecar automatic retries for stream endpoints in config, 3) ask customer to include unique idempotency per user session.

kyle-runtime: I'll prepare a small patch to the sidecar to: forward resume/idempotency headers on retries, and add a feature-flag to disable aggressive retries for `POST /v1/streams`/SSE endpoints. Will open PR this afternoon.

deploy-bot: new build pushed to canary: sidecar v1.12.4-canary with header-forward patch (rolling canary to 10% infra).

maria-cs: Thanks. Customer wants ETA and whether we can credit the duplicate billing.

dave-oncall: we should offer a manual credit for affected tokens; finance OK for 1-2 incidents pending engineering fix. Maria, please capture the customer session ids and total token delta and file billing ticket.

maria-cs: Will do — sent follow-up to ACME requesting session ids + a short recording. Also told them we're rolling a canary update that addresses header forwarding and will follow up with credits. :pray:

kyle-runtime: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sidecar/pull/452 — patch forwards `X-Resume-Token` and `X-Idempotency-Key` on retry, and respects `Sidecar-Allow-Retry: false` header for stream endpoints. Added unit tests for race case.

ben-infra: after canary looks good, let's flip the feature-flag to disable retries for streams by default in the next deploy. Also need an observability metric for "duplicate-stream-replay" so we can detect recurrence.

maria-cs: I'll update the customer thread and include ETA ~48h for rollout and confirm credit steps.

dave-oncall: great. create incident follow-up doc + postmortem if we see more than 3 customers in 24h. Assigning follow-ups: kyle -> engineering fix/PR, ben -> infra rollout and metric, maria -> billing + customer comms.

maria-cs: noted. thanks all.
